> I downloaded that 0.3.2 but he wont find my band on the list anywey

In this case, you doing something wrong.   Please try to regenerate auth code and connect your band from the scratch.. For this, open patched MiFit app. If you already have a paired miband here, unpair it. Then go to /sdcard/freemyband folder and delete all files here.
After this pair your band again. Now, go to xdrip miband menu. Switch off the option “Use miband”, and then clear fields “mac address” and “auth key”. Now, switch on the option “Use miband”. You should see that your miband was found and succesfully authentificated. If not, recheck that mac address which was automatically found is the same as on your band and correct it in the “mac address” field. The mac address can be found in the mifit application.
I did everything as it says above that version will not find my band at all this one that i downloaded will find everthing ok but there is still nothing on the screen

System status shows Miband connected and authenticated. 
Using XDrip Version 0.3.2. from above link and having the App fromm "freemyband" installed.

Can anyone give advice what to do?
Hi Klettervirus, have you tried enabling or disabling the "high MTU value" option under Settings->Smart Watch Features->MiBand?
